title: Chicken Satay with Indian Spices
description: A twist on the classic Southeast Asian dish, with the bold flavors of India. Grilled chicken skewers served with a side of spicy peanut sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together curry powder, garam masala, salt, and 1 tablespoon vegetable oil.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Grill the chicken for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the peanut sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve the grilled chicken with a side of peanut sauce and garnish with roasted peanuts.
To make the peanut sauce, combine roasted peanuts, peanut sauce, and 2 tablespoons water in a blender or food processor.
Blend until smooth, then season with salt to taste.
